newsitem.title: UK: Vodafone says AT&T has made no approach.
newsitem.headline: Vodafone says AT&T has made no approach.

text.p: The chief executive-designate of Britain's biggest mobile 'phone company Vodafone Plc said on Tuesday that the group had not been approached by U.S. telecom giant AT&T to discuss a possible merger or takeover.
"We haven't been approached (by AT&T), but anything is possible," Christopher Gent told Reuters after announcing the company's results for the first half of its financial year.
Although he said he could not categorically rule out such talks taking place in future, he doubted they would happen.

Industry observers have predicted a period of intense restructuring among international telecoms firms in the aftermath of this month's giant merger deal between British Telecommunications Plc and MCI Corp.
